title: Lasted only 4 months
text:
Lasted only 4 months. I purchased this item at Amazon after my Rival coffee maker -- several years old -- appeared to be slowing down. The Mr. Coffee coffee maker lasted only four months; the pump (moving the water from the reservoir through the drip filter and into the glass carafe) stopped working.

I had cleaned-up and set-aside my old Rival with the idea of giving it to charity but found that it "saved the day" on the morning when Mr. Coffee stopped working.

product_metadata.title: Mr. Coffee Simple Brew 12-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker, Black
features: Delay Brew timer lets you brew ahead of time, so you can wake up to fresh-brewed coffee
Grab-A-Cup Auto Pause stops cycle if you need a cup before brewing is finished
Dual water window allows visibility as you fill—no more overflows
Removable filter basket for quick and easy cleanup
2-Hour Shut Off automatically powers coffee maker down so you don't have to
description: The classic functionality of Mr. Coffee's Simple Brew 12-Cup Coffee Maker helps you make rich-tasting, expertly brewed coffee without stress or mess. Should you need a cup before the brew cycle is finished, Grab-A-Cup Auto Pause is a lifesaver. It stops brewing so you can pour freely, and then finishes the brewing cycle after you place the carafe back in position. It also features a removable basket filter that lifts out for quick and easy filling and cleaning. Whether you want a single cup or 12, this no-fuss automatic coffee maker will deliver the goods, time after time.
